comment: WHICH SOURCE this plugin acquires its Entwurf runtime from, and it is committed on purpose (#116 M3-b3): an environment variable or a caller flag would let the acquisition authority be chosen by whoever happens to be running, and a fallback would turn an unreachable source into 'install something else'. `herdr-checkout` packs the exact commit Herdr checked out, from the fixed junghan0611/entwurf remote, so a candidate needs no npm release; the `npm` branch (name+version+integrity) remains the production authority and is switched to by an explicit deactivate/activate, never inherited. 0.23.1 CANDIDATE WINDOW: this is the carrier the cut rides, because an npm lock must name a version that is already published AND coherent with this checkout's package.json, and the version bump lands before the publish. The npm pin returns as a follow-up commit once 0.23.1 is on the registry, with its published sha512 — the dd84ac0 pattern.
